changes: 💾 Closed the Group Chat backup gap — the Ledger's backup export now includes Group Chat, Syndy's Book, Leg Bets, and Acts of God history (none of it was covered before, since all of it lives outside the Ledger's own state). Clear Chat now also auto-archives everything it's about to delete before deleting it, rather than that data just being gone.

🎉 New: a direct "you won" push notification when a Syndy's Book market or Leg Bet resolves in your favour — previously the only way to find out was spotting the announcement in Group Chat. Works for both the automated scheduled resolution and a manual admin resolve. New send-payout-notify.mjs function, and syndy-book-scheduled.mjs updated — both need deploying.
